_comment: Technical data-handling inventory. This file does not publish or approve legal policy wording.
local_credentials: Reads the signed-in user's Claude and Codex credentials locally. Existing optional Claude login refresh may contact Anthropic or invoke the Claude CLI. Credentials are never included in usage relay responses or browser settings responses.
stored_usage: Stores usage windows, reset times, billing summary, timestamps and the configured source label in local usage history. Diagnostic logs record source failures without relay access keys.

optional_relay.transport: Authenticated HTTP on the user's trusted private LAN; HTTP is not encrypted. No automatic cloud upload or public port forwarding.
optional_relay.authentication: Separate relay access key, stored in a user-restricted token file on the host and local settings on the viewer. Browser settings responses omit secret values.
optional_relay.polling: One background usage poll every three minutes on the relay host. Viewers read the cached snapshot; failed polls invalidate it until recovery.
optional_relay.startup: Opt-in Windows task runs under the signed-in Claude user and restarts after process failure. Removing the task preserves local files.

lan_viewing: The existing optional phone/browser UI serves usage and source labels on the user's LAN.
launcher_spend: Reads the existing locally synchronized Agents & Inference summary; this change adds no new external spend destination.
